exposure: soluble form of lectin-like oxidized low-density lipoprotein receptor-1 (sLOX-1) levels
cohort: The study enrolled 27 infants with HIE and 45 control infants, all with gestational age ≥36 weeks and birth weight ≥1800 g.
finding: sLOX-1 levels measured within 6 hours after birth were correlated with HIE severity, differentiating moderate-severe HIE from mild HIE, and predicting intact survival versus death or neurosensory impairment in infants receiving therapeutic hypothermia.
cross-section timing: sLOX-1 level within 6 hours after birth
